summary: Corrected the two overstated/understated cost claims (R2-005: full-drain relay publish is 40 requests / 33% of budget, not 20/17%; R2-006: one attacking source already out-drains a refilling victim at two to one, not two sources), finished the eleven-site prose migration from t26-replenishment-design.md:525-540 (nine of eleven sites were unedited; corrected the six documentation files plus one unenumerated twelfth site in prd.md, left three locations in one test file for a test task), re-measured (not computed) the e2e suite's file/test counts and wall-clock across four documents that all carried the same stale 6-files/29-tests/4m52.6s figure, and recorded the ~194-day one-time-prekey exhaustion bound from R2-010 as a new open limitation. Documentation only: no source, test, or script file changed, package.json untouched. Concern carried forward: three test files still carry stale prose or wrong figures and must be fixed by a test task, since editing them was out of this task's scope; and my own re-run of the e2e suite failed under host contention from two other concurrently-running flow-003 agents, so the corrected wall-clock cites T25 round 2's idle figure (885.14s) rather than a fresh idle measurement of my own.
